definition: [ חָרַג ] verb quake (compare (si vera lectio) Arabic be straitened, unable to move for fear and rage ( Lane ), also put oneself in a rage ( Dozy ); ᵑ7 חַרְגַת מוֺתָא Deut 32:25 terror of death ) — only Qal Imperfect 3 masculine plural וְיַחְרְגוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֺתֵיהֶם Ps 18:46 pregnantly and come quaking out of their fortresses (compare יִרְגְּזוּ in like connection Mic 7:17 ); read the same also in || 2Sam 22:46 (for ᵑ0 וְיַחְגְרוּ , see חגר ; possible would be also ויחרדו in both, as Hos 11:10 ; Hos 11:11 etc.)

[חָרַג] verb quake (compare (si vera lectio) Arabic be straitened, unable to move for fear and rage (Lane), also put oneself in a rage (Dozy); ᵑ7 חַרְגַת מוֺתָא Deut 32:25 terror of death) — only Qal Imperfect 3 masculine plural וְיַחְרְגוּ מִמִּסְגְּרוֺתֵיהֶם Ps 18:46 pregnantly and come quaking out of their fortresses (compare יִרְגְּזוּ in like connection Mic 7:17); read the same also in || 2Sam 22:46 (for ᵑ0 וְיַחְגְרוּ, see חגר; possible would be also ויחרדו in both, as Hos 11:10; Hos 11:11 etc.)
